Accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main de leurs outils informatiques. Garantir une communication claire, professionnelle et adaptée à chaque interlocuteur. Configurer les connexions réseau et les accès Internet. Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau. Gérer les arrivées et départs des collaborateurs (préparation et récupération du matériel). Assurer le suivi des interventions de réparation et de maintenance. Mettre à jour l'inventaire du parc informatique. Participer à la gestion des stocks de matériels et consommables. Organisation et suivi Planifier et coordonner les interventions sur les différents sites. Assurer le suivi des demandes et des incidents. Appliquer les procédures internes et les règles de sécurité informatique. Votre profil Nous recherchons avant tout une personne impliquée, dynamique et dotée d'un excellent sens du service. Vous êtes à l'aise dans les échanges avec les utilisateurs et savez adopter une posture professionnelle, courtoise et rassurante. Connaissance des outils bureautiques et de la messagerie d'entreprise. Notions de base en réseaux et connectivité Internet. Connaissance du diagnostic et de la résolution d'incidents informatiques. Familiarité avec la gestion de parc informatique et les équipements audiovisuels. Soft Skills Excellent sens du service et de la relation utilisateur. Très bonne présentation et comportement professionnel. Bon relationnel, écoute et capacité à communiquer. Autonomie, réactivité et sens de l'organisation. Ponctualité, rigueur et esprit d'équipe. Capacité à s'adapter à différents interlocuteurs et environnements. Pourquoi rejoindre DIGWAY ? Rejoindre DIGWAY, c'est faire le choix d'une ESN spécialisée dans l'accompagnement de projets de transformation technologique et digitale, principalement via la délégation de compétences (mise à disposition d'experts auprès de nos clients pour intervenir sur un projet ou une mission concrète, avec des objectifs précis et une réelle valeur ajoutée). Des interventions auprès d'organisations variées, exigeantes et à forts enjeux IT. Un accompagnement personnalisé et un suivi de proximité tout au long de votre mission. Une montée en compétences continue grâce à des environnements professionnels stimulants. Une culture orientée expertise, performance et engagement projet. Prêt(e) à rejoindre l'aventure DIGWAY ? Vous souhaitez développer vos compétences en informatique, évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et mettre votre sens du service au profit des utilisateurs ? Postulez dès maintenant et échangeons ensemble sur cette opportunité !

Key responsibilities: • Kick off within the first week, agree the year's delivery plan, dates and approvers, and send the first report as a baseline • Track every deliverable in the client's tier each month and chase the newsroom and development when anything is late • Present the monthly proof-of-delivery report and run client reviews • Be the client's single contact, escalate complaints within 24 hours and collect a satisfaction score each quarter • Start renewal talks 90 days before expiry and aim to sign 30 days before • Grow the account: second-department packages, tier upgrades and one-off services • Follow up invoices with the client, since revenue only counts once it is collected Requirements: • 3 or more years in account management, client service or customer success in a B2B setting • Has carried a retention or growth number, not only a service role • Organized enough to run 20 accounts and their delivery calendars at once • Arabic and English, both fluent • Media, marketing or financial services background is an advantage

review_candidates.title: Sales Service Representative
review_candidates.description: Company Description MetLife is a global financial services company that provides insurance, annuities, employee benefits, and asset management solutions to individuals and institutions. Founded in 1868, MetLife operates in more than 40 markets worldwide, with leading positions in the United States, Japan, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. The company is focused on becoming a simpler, more customer-centered, and future-ready organization, offering flexible products and intuitive experiences to meet evolving needs. MetLife is committed to being a trusted partner, helping customers navigate change and manage life’s challenges with confidence. Role Description The Sales Service Representative is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo. This role is responsible for supporting customers and distribution partners by providing accurate information about MetLife products and services, assisting with policy inquiries, and guiding customers through application, enrollment, and servicing processes. The Sales Service Representative will handle incoming calls and inquiries, prepare and follow up on quotations and proposals, and coordinate closely with the sales team to help achieve sales and retention objectives. Day-to-day responsibilities include maintaining up-to-date product knowledge, resolving customer issues in a timely manner, documenting interactions in internal systems, and adhering to regulatory and company compliance standards. The role also involves identifying opportunities to enhance customer experiences and recommending solutions that align with customer needs and MetLife’s offerings. Qualifications Customer service and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, listen actively, and handle inquiries professionally. Sales support capabilities, including basic sales techniques, lead follow-up, and experience preparing proposals or quotations. Administrative and organizational skills, such as accurate data entry, documentation, and time management in a fast-paced environment. Analytical and problem-solving abilities to understand customer needs, interpret policy information, and resolve issues efficiently. Proficiency with office software and CRM or contact center tools, and comfort learning new systems and processes. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic fluency is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Cairo, collaborate within a team, and maintain a professional, customer-focused attitude. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; prior experience in insurance or financial services is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Customer Care Specialist &E-commerce Operations
review_candidates.description: We're hiring: E-commerce Operations & Customer Care Specialist Hethara Cosmetics · Fifth Settlement, Cairo · Full time, on-site Hethara is an Egyptian luxury skincare brand. We are looking for someone to own our online orders from the moment they are placed until they reach the client, and to look after our clients on every channel. What you will do • Process hethara.com orders on Shopify the same day and keep every order's status up to date. • Create shipments on Bosta, follow each one until it is delivered, and solve failed deliveries the same day. • Handle returns: restock on Shopify and record the reason. • Reply to client messages on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and email the same day. • Call previous clients to bring them back for repeat orders. • Send a short daily report and a weekly summary. What we are looking for • At least 1 year of experience in operations and customer service for an online store. • Hands-on experience with Shopify and Bosta. This is a must. • A warm, confident phone manner and clear written Arabic. Good English is a plus. • Organised, and comfortable with Google Sheets. What we offer • Basic salary: EGP 9,000 per month. • Monthly commission on the orders you close: up to EGP 3,000. • Total: up to EGP 12,000 per month. • Sunday to Thursday 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Saturday half day 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Friday off. • 3-month probation with clear monthly targets.

review_candidates.title: HEAD OF IT PMO
review_candidates.description: Location: Medellín, Antioquia, CO, 050010 Sabaneta, Antioquia, CO, 055450 Bello, Antioquia, CO, 51050 Requisition ID: 20327 About Holcim Holcim builds progress for people and the planet. As a global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions, Holcim is enabling greener cities, smarter infrastructure and improving living standards around the world. With sustainability at the core of its strategy Holcim is becoming a net zero company, with its people and communities at the heart of its success. The company is driving the circular economy as a world leader in recycling to build more with less. Holcim is the company behind some of the world’s most trusted brands in the building sector including ACC, Aggregate Industries, Disensa, Firestone Building Products, Geocycle, Holcim and Lafarge. Holcim is 70,000 people around the world who are passionate about building progress for people and the planet through four business segments: Cement, Ready-Mix Concrete, Aggregates and Solutions & Products. Americas Digital Center (ADC) is one of Holcim’s three global hubs driving digital transformation. As a strategic ally within our Global IT organization, our team of 400+ professionals enables global operations through expertise in Data Analytics, Cloud Computing, and Global Vendor Management. We are part of Holcim, the world leader in sustainable building solutions. Together with 45,000 colleagues worldwide, we are on a mission to decarbonize construction and improve living standards through innovation. As a certified Top Employer, we offer an exceptional environment where visionary talent thrives. We look for disruptive thinkers ready to embrace new challenges and shape the future of technology in a culture of continuous growth. At Holcim, we are looking for our next Head of IT PMO to lead how we deliver: one global project management methodology, delivery assurance and transparent reporting for the largest program portfolio in our history. You will be part of the Transformation Office, at a moment when the organization is moving from three regional delivery hubs to one global product-and-platform organization. Your Mission in the Role You will be the key player in making sure that what is decided gets delivered well: you will replace three delivery practices with one pragmatic methodology, protect the programs that cannot fail during the transformation and build a global project management community. Delivery excellence is a condition for the transformation's credibility. Key Responsibilities Lead the global delivery methodology: framework, tools, templates and quality gates, retiring regional variants. Define the interface between agile product delivery and stage-gated program management, so clusters work one way and programs cut over safely. Run delivery assurance: independent health checks, gate reviews and recovery support for programs in distress. Operate one single delivery reporting for GDS leadership, the Transformation Office and business committees, covering capacity, budget and risk management. Build and lead the global project manager community across Colombia, Spain and India, with a common career path, certification standard and staffing pool. Must-Have Requirements Experience: Minimum of 10 years in IT program and portfolio delivery, including leadership of a global or multi-country PMO. ERP and transformation programs: Delivery of large programs, with firsthand experience of cutovers, hypercare and go/no-go decisions. Methodology: Command of agile delivery (Scrum/SAFe) and stage-gated management (PMI/PRINCE2), with the judgment to know when to apply each. Assurance: Experience establishing or overhauling a methodology in a matrixed organization and turning around at least one distressed program. #HOLCIMADC On top of all, you will work in an amazing working environment, with great career opportunities that can be shaped from day 1, a ton of amazing talent to learn from, social responsibility activities, fun month’s end fridays and much, much more. Join ADC now! Tech in the Make. Did we spark your interest? Build your future with us and apply.
